titre: Commerce GCE O Level Paper 1 – Original Paper No. 1

exercices.enonce_intro_markdown: **Paper 1 - Multiple choice (1 hour 30 minutes).** Answer ALL 50 questions. All questions carry equal marks (1 mark each). Each question has four suggested answers A, B, C and D: choose only one answer for each question.

questions.enonce_markdown: A business owned by its members, in which each member has one vote whatever the number of shares held, is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
In a co-operative society the members own the business and control it democratically: one member, one vote.

Votes are given to persons, not to shares, so the business is a co-operative society. In a company, votes follow the number of shares held.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
In a public limited company the more shares a person holds, the more votes he has.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Co-operative societies
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: In a co-operative society the members own the business and control it democratically: one member, one vote.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following accounts is operated mainly by means of a cheque book?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A current account is opened by people and firms who make many payments: it is used with a cheque book and pays little or no interest.

Cheques are written to make payments from the account, so it is a current account.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A savings account is for keeping money and earning interest; withdrawals are made mainly with a passbook or a withdrawal slip.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Banking Services: accounts, loans and everyday services
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A current account is opened by people and firms who make many payments: it is used with a cheque book and pays little or no interest.

questions.enonce_markdown: The cheapest means of carrying very heavy and bulky goods over long distances between continents is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Ships carry very large quantities at a low cost per tonne; they are slow but cheap.

For heavy and bulky goods that cross oceans, the cost per tonne is lowest by sea.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
Air transport is the fastest but the most expensive.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Transport in Commerce: choosing the right means for the goods
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Ships carry very large quantities at a low cost per tonne; they are slow but cheap.

questions.enonce_markdown: An advertisement that tries to persuade consumers to leave one brand and buy a rival brand is classified as:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Competitive advertising promotes one brand against rival brands; informative advertising gives facts; generic advertising promotes a whole kind of product.

The aim is to win customers from rival brands, so the advertising is competitive.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Generic advertising does not name a brand: it promotes the product as a whole, for example milk or tea.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Advertising and Sales Promotion: informing, persuading and boosting sales
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Competitive advertising promotes one brand against rival brands; informative advertising gives facts; generic advertising promotes a whole kind of product.

questions.enonce_markdown: A shop buys a radio at CFAF 60,000 and sells it at CFAF 78,000. The mark-up is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Mark-up is the profit expressed as a percentage of the COST price: mark-up = profit ÷ cost price × 100. Margin is the profit as a percentage of the SELLING price.

Profit = 78,000 − 60,000 = 18,000. Mark-up = 18,000 ÷ 60,000 × 100 = 30%.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
23% is the margin (18,000 ÷ 78,000 × 100), calculated on the selling price.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Profit and Mark-up Calculations: from cost price to margin
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Mark-up is the profit expressed as a percentage of the COST price: mark-up = profit ÷ cost price × 100. Margin is the profit as a percentage of the SELLING price.

questions.enonce_markdown: An insurance policy that pays a sum of money to the family of the policyholder when he dies is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Life assurance pays a sum of money on the death of the insured person, or at the end of an agreed period.

The sum is paid to the family at the death of the policyholder, so the policy is life assurance.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
Fire, motor and burglary policies protect property against loss: they do not depend on the death of a person.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Types of insurance
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Life assurance pays a sum of money on the death of the insured person, or at the end of an agreed period.

questions.enonce_markdown: A large retail shop in which customers pick the goods themselves from the shelves and pay at the exit is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A supermarket sells mainly foodstuffs and household goods by self-service: customers serve themselves and pay at the checkout.

Self-service from shelves with payment at the exit describes a supermarket.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
A mail order firm sells through catalogues and posts the goods; a hawker moves from place to place.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Retail Trade: types of retailers and what they offer
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A supermarket sells mainly foodstuffs and household goods by self-service: customers serve themselves and pay at the checkout.

questions.enonce_markdown: The document that a buyer sends to a seller to ask for the supply of goods is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
The business documents follow the sale in order: enquiry, quotation, order, delivery note, invoice, statement of account.

The buyer starts the purchase by sending an order to the seller.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
The invoice is made by the seller after the order, to ask for payment.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business Documents: from order to payment
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: The business documents follow the sale in order: enquiry, quotation, order, delivery note, invoice, statement of account.

questions.enonce_markdown: A cheque that the bank refuses to pay because the account of the drawer has too little money is said to be:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A dishonoured cheque is a cheque that the bank returns unpaid, for example because of insufficient funds in the drawer's account.

The bank refuses payment for lack of funds: the cheque is dishonoured.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Crossing a cheque only limits the way it is paid: it does not make the bank refuse it.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Methods of Payment: from cash to cheques and transfers
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A dishonoured cheque is a cheque that the bank returns unpaid, for example because of insufficient funds in the drawer's account.

questions.enonce_markdown: The document that a public company publishes to invite the public to buy its shares is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A prospectus gives information about the company and its plans so that the public can decide to buy shares.

The invitation to the public is made by the prospectus.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
The articles of association are the internal rules of the company, and a share certificate is the proof of ownership given to a shareholder: neither is an invitation to buy shares.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Company Formation Documents: who needs which paper and when
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A prospectus gives information about the company and its plans so that the public can decide to buy shares.

questions.enonce_markdown: Goods that a Cameroonian firm sends to another country to be sold there are called:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Exports are goods and services sold to other countries; imports are goods and services bought from other countries.

Goods leaving Cameroon to be sold abroad are exports.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
Imports are goods that come into the country, not goods that leave it.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Foreign trade concepts
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Exports are goods and services sold to other countries; imports are goods and services bought from other countries.

questions.enonce_markdown: Banking, insurance, transport, advertising and warehousing are together called:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Aids to trade are the services that help trade to take place by removing hindrances such as distance, risk, lack of money and lack of knowledge.

These services assist trade, so they are the aids to trade.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Primary activities take materials from nature, for example farming and fishing.

rappels_de_methode.competence: The Scope of Commerce: trade, aids to trade and the hindrances they remove
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Aids to trade are the services that help trade to take place by removing hindrances such as distance, risk, lack of money and lack of knowledge.

questions.enonce_markdown: A letter that the post office records on posting and delivery, and for which it pays compensation if it is lost, is sent by:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Registered post gives a receipt on posting and a signature on delivery, with compensation if the item is lost.

The record and the compensation are the features of registered post.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
Ordinary post is the cheapest service but it has no record of posting or delivery.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Communication Services: matching post, courier and phone to the need
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Registered post gives a receipt on posting and a signature on delivery, with compensation if the item is lost.

questions.enonce_markdown: A bank customer who is allowed to withdraw more than the balance on his current account, up to an agreed limit, has an:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
An overdraft lets a current account holder draw more than he has, up to a limit; interest is paid only on the amount overdrawn.

Withdrawing more than the balance, up to a limit, is an overdraft.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A fixed deposit is money that the customer lends to the bank for an agreed period: it is not a borrowing by the customer.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Banking Services: accounts, loans and everyday services
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: An overdraft lets a current account holder draw more than he has, up to a limit; interest is paid only on the amount overdrawn.

questions.enonce_markdown: An agent who sells goods for a principal, is paid by commission and does not become the owner of the goods is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A commission agent works for a principal, never owns the goods and receives a percentage of the value of the sales.

The three features (works for a principal, paid by commission, no ownership) describe a commission agent.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A wholesaler and a retailer buy the goods and become their owners before selling them.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Agents: brokers, factors, indents and commission
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A commission agent works for a principal, never owns the goods and receives a percentage of the value of the sales.

questions.enonce_markdown: A cargo ship that sails on a fixed route and keeps to a fixed timetable is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A liner follows a regular route and timetable; a tramp has no fixed route and sails where cargo is available.

A fixed route and a timetable describe a liner.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
A tramp goes wherever there is cargo to carry, at any time.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Transport in Commerce: choosing the right means for the goods
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A liner follows a regular route and timetable; a tramp has no fixed route and sails where cargo is available.

questions.enonce_markdown: A trader's average stock is CFAF 2,000,000 and his cost of goods sold during the year is CFAF 12,000,000. His rate of stock turnover is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Rate of stock turnover = cost of goods sold ÷ average stock. It shows how many times the stock is sold and replaced during the period.

12,000,000 ÷ 2,000,000 = 6 times.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
24 times comes from multiplying the two figures instead of dividing.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Rate of Stock Turnover: measuring how fast stock is sold
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Rate of stock turnover = cost of goods sold ÷ average stock. It shows how many times the stock is sold and replaced during the period.

questions.enonce_markdown: The following are features of a sole proprietorship EXCEPT:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A sole proprietor owns the whole business, takes all the profit and bears all the losses; the business has no shares to sell to the public.

A sole proprietorship has no shares: it is owned by one person. The other three statements are features of this form of business.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
Shares quoted on a stock exchange belong to public limited companies.

choix.texte: It is easy to set up.
The owner takes all the profit.
Its shares are sold on the stock exchange.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business Ownership Types: who owns, who risks, who decides
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A sole proprietor owns the whole business, takes all the profit and bears all the losses; the business has no shares to sell to the public.

questions.enonce_markdown: An advertisement painted on a large board beside a main road is an example of:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Outdoor advertising uses billboards, posters, signs on vehicles and other displays placed in public places.

A board by the roadside is a public display, so it is outdoor advertising.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Press advertising uses newspapers and magazines; broadcast advertising uses radio and television.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Advertising and Sales Promotion: informing, persuading and boosting sales
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Outdoor advertising uses billboards, posters, signs on vehicles and other displays placed in public places.

questions.enonce_markdown: The person who visits the scene of a loss and reports to the insurance company on the size of the loss is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A loss assessor (or adjuster) investigates a claim and advises the insurer on the amount to be paid.

Investigating the loss and reporting its size is the work of the loss assessor.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
An actuary studies risks and calculates premiums: he does not visit the scene of a loss.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Insurance Principles: how a claim is judged and paid
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A loss assessor (or adjuster) investigates a claim and advises the insurer on the amount to be paid.

questions.enonce_markdown: The document that is signed by the customer on receipt of the goods, to prove that they were delivered, is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A delivery note is sent with the goods; the customer signs a copy as proof that he received them.

Proof of delivery signed by the customer is the delivery note.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
The invoice states the price and asks for payment: it is not signed as proof of delivery.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business Documents: from order to payment
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A delivery note is sent with the goods; the customer signs a copy as proof that he received them.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is NOT a retailer?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Retailers sell goods in small quantities to the final consumers; wholesalers sell in large quantities to retailers.

The wholesaler sells to retailers and not to the final consumers. The other three sell to consumers.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
A mail order firm is a retailer: it sells to consumers, but through catalogues and the post.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Retail Trade: types of retailers and what they offer
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Retailers sell goods in small quantities to the final consumers; wholesalers sell in large quantities to retailers.

questions.enonce_markdown: A document sent by a bank to a current account holder, showing the money paid in, the money paid out and the balance, is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A bank statement lists the transactions on an account over a period, with the balance after each of them, and shows the bank charges.

A list of the deposits, the payments and the balance is a bank statement.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A pay-in slip is filled by the customer when he deposits money: it comes from the customer, not from the bank.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Banking Services: accounts, loans and everyday services
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A bank statement lists the transactions on an account over a period, with the balance after each of them, and shows the bank charges.

questions.enonce_markdown: A country that imports goods in order to export them again, with little or no change, carries on:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Entrepot trade means importing goods for re-export. Ports that serve neighbouring countries often live on this trade.

Importing in order to export again is entrepot trade.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
Home trade takes place between traders of the same country.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Foreign trade concepts
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Entrepot trade means importing goods for re-export. Ports that serve neighbouring countries often live on this trade.

questions.enonce_markdown: A trader sells goods with a list price of CFAF 50,000 and allows a trade discount of 20%. The price shown on the invoice is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Trade discount is a reduction from the list price, given to traders who buy for resale; the invoice shows the list price less the trade discount.

Trade discount = 20% of 50,000 = 10,000. Invoice price = 50,000 − 10,000 = 40,000.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
CFAF 10,000 is the amount of the discount, not the price that remains to be paid.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Trade and Cash Discounts: from the list price to the amount actually paid
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Trade discount is a reduction from the list price, given to traders who buy for resale; the invoice shows the list price less the trade discount.

questions.enonce_markdown: The person who is responsible for receiving, storing and issuing the goods kept in a warehouse is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
The storekeeper receives the goods, stores them safely, issues them against a written request and keeps the stock records.

Receiving, storing and issuing goods is the work of the storekeeper.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A cashier handles money, not goods.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Warehousing: choosing the right store and keeping stock records
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: The storekeeper receives the goods, stores them safely, issues them against a written request and keeps the stock records.

questions.enonce_markdown: A means of payment that a bank draws on itself, so that the payee is sure to be paid, is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A bank draft is bought from a bank, which draws it on itself: the bank promises to pay, so it cannot be dishonoured for lack of funds.

A cheque drawn by the bank on itself is a bank draft.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
A personal cheque is drawn on the customer's account and can be returned unpaid.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Methods of Payment: from cash to cheques and transfers
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A bank draft is bought from a bank, which draws it on itself: the bank promises to pay, so it cannot be dishonoured for lack of funds.

questions.enonce_markdown: The following are documents used between a buyer and a seller EXCEPT:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A pay-in slip is a banking document that a customer fills when he deposits money in his account.

The order, the invoice and the delivery note pass between the buyer and the seller. The pay-in slip is a document between a customer and his bank.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
A credit note, like an invoice, is a document that the seller sends to the buyer.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business Documents: from order to payment
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A pay-in slip is a banking document that a customer fills when he deposits money in his account.

questions.enonce_markdown: A manufacturer may sell directly to retailers because this:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
When the wholesaler is by-passed, his profit margin disappears from the price: the cost of distribution falls.

Selling directly to retailers removes the wholesaler and his margin, so the cost of distribution is reduced.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
Selling directly keeps the manufacturer's task of delivery, and sometimes adds to it.

choix.texte: Removes the need to deliver goods.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Channels of Distribution: how goods travel and when the wholesaler is by-passed
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: When the wholesaler is by-passed, his profit margin disappears from the price: the cost of distribution falls.

questions.enonce_markdown: The following are disadvantages of road transport EXCEPT:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Road transport is flexible and can serve places that have no railway; its weaknesses are small loads, congestion and poor road conditions.

Door-to-door delivery is an advantage of road transport. The three other statements are weaknesses.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Door-to-door service is the main reason why road transport is so widely used for short and medium distances.

choix.texte: Damage to goods on bad roads.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Transport in Commerce: choosing the right means for the goods
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Road transport is flexible and can serve places that have no railway; its weaknesses are small loads, congestion and poor road conditions.

questions.enonce_markdown: A shareholder who receives a fixed rate of dividend, and is paid before ordinary shareholders when profits are shared, holds:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Preference shareholders have a fixed rate of dividend and are paid before ordinary shareholders; they are owners of the company but have limited voting rights.

A fixed dividend paid first is the right of preference shareholders.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
Debenture holders are creditors who receive interest, not shareholders who receive dividends.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Company Securities: shares, debentures and what each investor earns
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Preference shareholders have a fixed rate of dividend and are paid before ordinary shareholders; they are owners of the company but have limited voting rights.

questions.enonce_markdown: A quotation sent by a seller to a buyer states:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A quotation is the answer to an enquiry: it gives the price, the delivery terms and the conditions of payment, and is not yet a sale.

The seller states what he is ready to supply and on what terms: price, delivery and payment.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
A quotation is not a bill: nothing has been sold when it is sent.

choix.texte: The goods lost on the way.
The price and terms on which the seller is ready to supply the goods.
The amount that the buyer has already paid.
The date on which the goods were delivered.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Price Quotations and Delivery Terms: who pays for carriage, loading and insurance
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A quotation is the answer to an enquiry: it gives the price, the delivery terms and the conditions of payment, and is not yet a sale.

questions.enonce_markdown: The following are advertising media EXCEPT the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Advertising media are the channels used to reach the public: radio, television, newspapers, posters, billboards and the internet.

An invoice is a business document between a seller and a buyer: it does not carry an advertisement to the public.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
Newspapers, radio and billboards are media; an invoice is not.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Advertising and Sales Promotion: informing, persuading and boosting sales
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Advertising media are the channels used to reach the public: radio, television, newspapers, posters, billboards and the internet.

questions.enonce_markdown: A temporary document that gives the insured cover until the policy is issued is a:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A cover note is issued by the insurer or his agent as temporary evidence of cover until the policy is ready.

A temporary proof of cover before the policy is issued is a cover note.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
The proposal form is filled by the person who wants the insurance, before any cover is given.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Insurance documents
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A cover note is issued by the insurer or his agent as temporary evidence of cover until the policy is ready.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following can a borrower offer to a bank as security for a loan?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A bank asks for security, such as a title deed or a life policy, that it can sell to recover the money if the borrower fails to repay.

A title deed is a valuable asset that the bank can hold and sell if the loan is not repaid.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
A bank statement only reports what has happened on an account: it has no value of its own.

choix.texte: The title deed of a piece of land.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Banking Services: accounts, loans and everyday services
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A bank asks for security, such as a title deed or a life policy, that it can sell to recover the money if the borrower fails to repay.

questions.enonce_markdown: The government department that collects import duties on goods entering Cameroon at the port of Douala is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
The customs department controls the goods that enter and leave the country and collects import and export duties.

Collecting duties on goods entering the country is the work of the customs department.

**Answer: D.**

### Piège à éviter
A chamber of commerce is an association of traders: it has no power to collect duties.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Customs administration
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: The customs department controls the goods that enter and leave the country and collects import and export duties.

questions.enonce_markdown: Goods have a net price of CFAF 80,000. Value added tax (VAT) is charged at 19.25%. The total price payable is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
VAT is added to the net price: total price = net price + net price × VAT rate.

VAT = 80,000 × 19.25 ÷ 100 = 15,400. Total price = 80,000 + 15,400 = 95,400.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
CFAF 15,400 is only the amount of the tax: the net price must be added.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Vat calculations
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: VAT is added to the net price: total price = net price + net price × VAT rate.

questions.enonce_markdown: A public limited company can raise more capital than a partnership mainly because it:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A public limited company issues shares to the public, so it can collect small sums from a very large number of investors.

Selling shares to the public gives access to a very large number of investors, whereas a partnership has only a few partners.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
In a public limited company the liability of the shareholders is limited: unlimited liability belongs to partners.

choix.texte: Can sell its shares to the general public.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Limited liability companies
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A public limited company issues shares to the public, so it can collect small sums from a very large number of investors.

questions.enonce_markdown: The agent who arranges the transport and the customs clearance of goods on behalf of an exporter is the:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A forwarding agent handles the documents, the customs clearance, the packing and the transport of goods for exporters and importers.

Arranging transport and customs clearance is the work of a forwarding agent.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
A del credere agent sells goods and guarantees that the buyers will pay.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Commercial Agents: brokers, factors, indents and commission
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: A forwarding agent handles the documents, the customs clearance, the packing and the transport of goods for exporters and importers.

questions.enonce_markdown: In a credit sale, the ownership of the goods passes to the buyer:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
In a credit sale the buyer becomes the owner at once and pays later; in hire purchase he becomes the owner only after the last instalment.

The buyer takes the goods and becomes their owner immediately, even though he pays later.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
Ownership after the last instalment is the rule of hire purchase, not of credit sale.

choix.texte: At the end of the year.
At the time of the sale.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Hire purchase
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: In a credit sale the buyer becomes the owner at once and pays later; in hire purchase he becomes the owner only after the last instalment.

questions.enonce_markdown: A small parcel of urgent medicines is to be sent to a distant country. The most suitable means of transport is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Air transport is the fastest means and suits light, valuable or urgent goods over long distances.

The parcel is small, urgent and travels far: air transport is the best choice.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
Sea transport is cheaper but slow: it does not suit urgent goods.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Transport in Commerce: choosing the right means for the goods
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Air transport is the fastest means and suits light, valuable or urgent goods over long distances.

questions.enonce_markdown: The main advantage of division of labour to a firm is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
In division of labour each worker does one task, so he becomes quicker and more skilled and the output per worker rises.

Repeating one task makes workers faster, so output per worker rises.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
Division of labour makes work repetitive and creates dependence between workers: these are disadvantages.

choix.texte: Workers who can do any job.
More interesting work for each worker.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Division of labour and specialisation
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: In division of labour each worker does one task, so he becomes quicker and more skilled and the output per worker rises.

questions.enonce_markdown: Money that a company keeps from its profits to finance its growth is:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Retained (ploughed-back) profit is an internal source of finance: it comes from the business itself.

Profit kept in the business is retained profit.

**Answer: B.**

### Piège à éviter
An overdraft, debentures and trade credit are borrowed from outside the business.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business funding sources
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Retained (ploughed-back) profit is an internal source of finance: it comes from the business itself.

questions.enonce_markdown: A trader buys goods with a list price of CFAF 200,000. He is allowed a trade discount of 25% and a cash discount of 4% for payment within 10 days. If he pays within 10 days, he pays:
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Trade discount is deducted from the list price first; cash discount is then calculated on the amount that remains to be paid, not on the list price.

Net invoice price = 200,000 − 25% of 200,000 = 150,000. Cash discount = 4% of 150,000 = 6,000. Amount paid = 150,000 − 6,000 = 144,000.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
CFAF 142,000 comes from taking the cash discount on the list price (4% of 200,000 = 8,000).

rappels_de_methode.competence: Trade and Cash Discounts: from the list price to the amount actually paid
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Trade discount is deducted from the list price first; cash discount is then calculated on the amount that remains to be paid, not on the list price.

questions.enonce_markdown: A small retailer who has no cash to buy stock for the next two weeks can best use:
questions.corrige_markdown:

Trade credit means buying goods now and paying the supplier later: it is a short-term source of finance.

The need is small and short, so buying on credit from suppliers is the best source.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
Mortgages, shares and debentures are long-term sources: they take time to arrange and suit large amounts.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Business funding sources
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Trade credit means buying goods now and paying the supplier later: it is a short-term source of finance.

questions.enonce_markdown: A Cameroonian importer buys goods at a CIF Douala price. Which of the following costs is paid by the importer and is NOT included in the CIF price?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
CIF means cost, insurance and freight: the seller pays the cost of the goods, the loading, the marine insurance and the freight up to the port named. Duties and the costs after arrival are paid by the buyer.

Insurance, freight and loading are included in a CIF price. The import duty is a tax of the importing country, paid by the importer.

**Answer: C.**

### Piège à éviter
CIF covers the transport and the insurance up to Douala, not the taxes due in Cameroon.

choix.texte: The cost of loading the goods on the ship.
The freight from the port of loading to Douala.
The marine insurance during the voyage.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Incoterms
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: CIF means cost, insurance and freight: the seller pays the cost of the goods, the loading, the marine insurance and the freight up to the port named. Duties and the costs after arrival are paid by the buyer.

questions.enonce_markdown: The body that supervises the commercial banks in the countries of Central Africa is:

Supervising the banks is the task of COBAC.

**Answer: A.**

### Piège à éviter
BEAC issues the CFA franc of Central Africa; BICEC is a commercial bank.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Central and commercial banks
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: COBAC (the Central African Banking Commission) controls the banks and credit institutions of the region; BEAC is the central bank that issues the currency.
